_note: Default slots so the set runs out of the box. Every organisation and issuer here is invented and every URL is under the reserved .example domain. A brand test means something only with brands people trust: copy this file, put your own brands, the issuers your processes accept and a URL you control in it, and pass it with --slots. PERSON is empty on purpose: add real people only with their consent (for example your own executives); without names ig-likeness is reported as not measured.
